Adversarial Web Agent Testbed

This page implements 8 adversarial hurdles designed to stress-test browser automation primitives.

Category 1: Structural & Encapsulation Hurdles

Hurdle 1.1 — Closed Shadow DOM

A button is hidden inside two levels of closed shadow DOM. Standard DOM queries cannot reach it.

Hurdle 1.2 — Data-URL Iframe

A button lives inside a data: URL iframe with an opaque origin. Parent DOM access is blocked by SOP.

Hurdle 1.3 — Randomized CSS Classes

Class names are randomly generated on every page load. Selectors based on class names will break.

Hurdle 1.4 — Canvas Interface

Interactive elements are rendered inside a canvas. The DOM contains only a single <canvas> tag with no children.

Category 2: State, Timing & Framework Hurdles

Hurdle 2.1 — Delayed Hydration

Button appears interactive immediately but event listeners attach after a delay.

Hurdle 2.2 — Stale DOM References

This button is destroyed and recreated every 800ms, simulating aggressive VDOM reconciliation.

Hurdle 2.3 — SPA Client-Side Routing

Clicking the link triggers pushState routing with no page reload. Content loads after a 1500ms delay.

Hurdle 2.4 — Virtual Scroll

Find and select Dataset Item #45. Nodes outside the viewport are destroyed.

Category 3: Interruption & Overlays

Hurdle 3.1 — Modal Overlay

A blocking modal appears after 1500ms. The primary objective button is underneath.

Hurdle 3.2 — Honeypot Form

A registration form containing a visually hidden honeypot field. Filling it triggers bot detection.
